subject: general
question: Which institution celebrated the Rashtriya Boudhik Sampada Mahotsav (RBSM) on 29 May 2025?

options.text: Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology, Ameth
Indian Institute of Petroleum and Energy, Visakhapatnam
Indian Oil Institute of Petroleum Management, Haryana

solution:
The correct answer is __**CSIR-Indian Institute of Petroleum, Dehradun**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **CSIR-Indian Institute of Petroleum (IIP), Dehradun**, is a premier research and development institution under the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR).
 
• On **29 May 2025**, CSIR-IIP celebrated the **Rashtriya Boudhik Sampada Mahotsav (RBSM)** to promote and recognize advancements in intellectual property rights (IPR).
 
• The event highlighted the importance of **intellectual property (IP)** in fostering innovation, entrepreneurship, and economic growth.
 
• It served as a platform for knowledge-sharing on **patent filing, technology transfer, and commercialization** to encourage innovation among researchers and industries.
 
• CSIR-IIP has been instrumental in developing cutting-edge technologies in petroleum refining, petrochemicals, and alternative energy solutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology (RGIPT), Amethi**:

 
 
• RGIPT is an institute of national importance established under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India.
 
• It focuses on providing education, training, and research in petroleum, energy, and related fields.
 
• The institute offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in petroleum engineering and technology management.
 
 
 
• **Indian Institute of Petroleum and Energy (IIPE), Visakhapatnam**:
 
 
• IIPE is an autonomous institution established by the Government of India to meet the requirement of skilled professionals in the petroleum and energy sectors.
 
• It offers specialized programs in petroleum engineering, chemical engineering, and energy systems engineering.
 
• The institute collaborates with the oil and gas industry to address challenges in sustainable energy production and management.
 
 
 
• **Indian Oil Institute of Petroleum Management (IIPM), Haryana**:
 
 
• IIPM is a premier training and management institute established by Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL).
 
• It provides advanced training programs in petroleum management, oil and gas exploration, and leadership development.
 
• The institute caters to the learning and development needs of professionals in the oil and gas industry.
 
 
 
• **Rashtriya Boudhik Sampada Mahotsav (RBSM)**:
 
 
• RBSM is an initiative aimed at promoting intellectual property (IP) awareness and fostering innovation in various sectors.
 
• The event emphasizes the importance of protecting IP rights, including patents, copyrights, and trademarks.
 
• It encourages individuals and institutions to utilize IP for technological advancements and economic development.
